items.answer: Two villages are completely cut off by road: an unnamed cluster with 36 buildings and another unnamed cluster with 33 buildings. An estimated 301 people are stranded in these villages. Additionally, Syabru Bensi, a suburb with 404 buildings, has lost 68% of its road connections, stranding an estimated 1,200 people.

items.q: How many people are cut off and how did you estimate it?
items.answer: An estimated 1,523 people are cut off by road. This number is derived by multiplying the number of buildings in each cut-off settlement by the average household size of 4.37 persons per household, based on the Nepal census 2021. The settlements include Syabru Bensi, unnamed clusters, and a hamlet, with varying degrees of road loss.
